evals.prompt: Show me the 14 day RSI for AAPL over the last month using Twelve Data.
evals.expected_output: A call to the /rsi endpoint with time_period=14 and interval=1day, not a manual RSI computation from candles.
assertions: Does not fetch raw candles and compute RSI in code

evals.prompt: I need MACD for BTC/USD but I also want to control which moving average types are used.
evals.expected_output: Routes to /macdext rather than /macd, because the moving average types are configurable there.
assertions: Explains that /macd uses fixed moving average types
Does not present /macd_slope as an equivalent option

evals.prompt: Compute a 200 period simple moving average for MSFT and plot it against price. I only need the last 30 points shown.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that a 200 period lookback needs more history than 30 points and raises outputsize or sets a date range.
assertions: Requests more history than the 30 points to be displayed
Mentions that early values are unavailable without enough warm-up data
